description: SECURITY (s441, F5). A block event handler calls a server function inside a `.sort` comparator. `.sort` has no awaited combinator (async merge-sort is not offered), so the call cannot be awaited: the comparator would compare Promises. In a function body this fails closed; before s441 a handler body skipped the check and shipped the bare call. It now fails closed with the peer-server-fn code.
rationale: §13.2 + §34 E-SERVER-FN-IN-SYNC-CALLBACK: a server call in a position where the compiler cannot insert `await` is a hard, fail-closed error — in an inline handler as in a function body (ruling S440 JS-WAT #11).
